'''Elevators''' ---- '''Elevators''' are one of the methods of starting a match. They require the player to enter a physical elevator in the lobby, which is set to start a match in a specific mode type and map, unless if they are part of a [[Party]] where the leader enters an elevator.
==Usage== [[File:ElevatorIcon.png|200px|thumb]] '''Elevators''' can be found inside the game's lobby. These will display the current the map it leads to, alongside the map name, creator and difficulty. At the bottom of the image, there is a progress bar, which at first displays the "''Waiting for Players...''" message. This changes to a timer when players have entered the elevator. At the right of the progress bar, the current number of players in the elevator is shown. On all elevators, it shows a floating label that indicates player size, which would display the timer after the server size had been set. Prior to [[v1.89.0]], this floating label would only exist on [[Challenge Trials]] elevators. After entering an elevator, it will ask the player that entered it for what party size they want it to be for. After choosing one, the timer for the elevator will start and a box will appear which displays nearly identical information to the map icon of the elevator. Once the timer finishes, the trapdoor seen beneath players opens and a plane will fly in the sky. ==Types of Elevators== Elevators are used for various game modes throughout the game. There are currently four types of elevators. ===Survival Elevators=== '''Survival Elevators''' have a maximum player limit of 4 and wait up to 20 seconds before starting a match. There are two Survival elevators for each available Survival difficulty, equating to a total of 12 in the [[Main Lobby]]. This will take players into the [[Survival Intermission Lobby]] where the map is decided by player votes, and the difficulty played is based on where the player(s) entered the elevator from. ===Hardcore Elevators=== '''Hardcore Elevators''' have a maximum player limit of 3 and wait up to 20 seconds before starting a match. There are two elevators in the lobby that takes players directly to a [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] match. Each '''Hardcore Elevator''' has a map the match will be started in, with the map changing every minute. ===Voidcore Elevators=== '''Voidcore Elevators''' have a maximum player limit of 3 and wait up to 20 seconds before starting a match. There is only one elevator that takes players to a [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] match—located between the two '''Hardcore Elevators'''—and it can only be entered by players who have beaten [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]]. Each '''Void Elevator''' has a map the match will be started in, with the map changing every minute. ===Story Mode Elevators=== '''Story Mode Elevators''' have a maximum player limit of 4 and wait up to 20 seconds before starting a match. The first player to enter the elevator will be able to choose the [[Story Mode|Story]] mode mission that the Elevator will start. As soon as the elevator departs, all players in that elevator are taken to that mission as selected by the player. [[Story Mode]] missions are also be playable through [[Matchmaking]]. ==Legacy Elevators== While currently, there are only four types of '''Elevators''' in the game, there used to be far more '''Elevators''' types in the game in the past. ===Original Survival Elevators=== '''Original Survival Elevators''' had a maximum player limit of 4 and wait up to 20 seconds to start a match. Each elevator had a map that would be changed every minute, and when the elevator departs all players would spawn in the map shown by the elevator, and the difficulty to be played would be decided by a player vote. If a player had the [[Gamepasses|VIP gamepass]], they would be able to place two votes on the difficulty. Since the [[v2.4.0]] update, survival elevators were overhauled and would have a fixed difficulty display that would always take players to a match of that difficulty, and maps are now determined by voting the same way that was done with survival [[Matchmaking]] since [[v1.5.0]]. '''Hardcore Elevators''' since then are the only elevators in the game that still use rotating maps. ===Special Elevators=== '''Special Elevators''' were a variant of '''Elevators''' which only hosted special maps. While currently, that only would include maps with special modes attached to them, it used to also lead to some maps with multiple paths due to them having [[All Paths]]. '''Special Elevators''' were not random and instead followed a specific order. The time for them to change and depart was also lowered. '''Special Elevators''' were first removed from private servers in [[v1.8.0]], then in [[v1.18.4]] they were also removed from public servers, making [[Matchmaking]] the only way to play special maps. ===Challenge Trials Elevators=== '''Challenge Trials Elevators''' were a variant of elevators that would take players to a [[Challenge Trials]] match that would play with the respective modifier and map that was shown in the [[Main Lobby]]. There were four of them, each with a maximum player limit of 4, that waited up to 20 seconds before starting a match. '''Challenge Trials Elevators''' have been removed since [[v2.4.0]], and that game mode is now only playable through [[Matchmaking]]. ===Event Elevators=== '''Event Elevators''' were '''Elevators''' which generally only housed a single map, though at one point could cycle between two. They were used to access event maps and their respective modes. The [[Frost Invasion Event]] was the last event in the game to fully make use of '''Event Elevators''', as they have since been replaced by [[Matchmaking]] starting with the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. Although '''Event Elevators''' were briefly brought back with the [[Null & Void Event]] in favor of the upgraded elevators in [[v1.75.0]], they were replaced by [[Matchmaking]] again in [[v1.78.0]] and matchmaking was used for the majority of the time the [[Null & Void Event]] was available. ===MEGA Elevators=== '''MEGA Elevators''' were a type of '''Elevators''' which would lead players into [[MEGA Servers]]. [[MEGA Servers]] could go up to six players, or in the past eight. As the increased player count would make the game far easier, special effects would be applied to make the game harder. This included reduced player count, health scaling, reduced sell values and smaller wave bonuses. At one point, tower upgrade costs were also increased. '''MEGA Elevators''' existed in the game since its first public release in [[BETA v1.0]], and would later be removed in [[v1.3.0]], replaced by '''Special Elevators'''. While no modern alternative exists outside of bugs, [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] does allow for matches with more than four players. ===Solo, Duo & Trio Elevators=== '''Solo Elevators''', '''Duo Elevators''' and '''Trio Elevators''' were a variant of '''Elevators''' which only allowed one, two or three players inside of them instead of the usual four or higher player counts. '''Duo Elevators''' were first added in [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.1]], while '''Solo Elevators''' and '''Trio Elevators''' were added in [[Release v1.8|Release v1.8.1]]. All three would be removed in [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]], though [[Matchmaking]] does provide options for all player counts. ===Versus Elevators=== '''Versus Elevators''' were a type of '''Elevators''' which would lead players into a [[Versus]] match. Unlike other types of '''Elevators''', there would be two separate elevators for each team. '''Versus Elevators''' could hold up to eight players each map, with only four players per elevator. '''Versus Elevators''' were added in [[BETA v1.9]] and removed in [[Release v1.8]]. As of modern versions, [[PVP|Versus]]/[[PVP]] can only be played through [[Matchmaking]] and teams would instead be randomly assigned. ==Trivia== *Prior to [[BETA v1.7]], the button used to exit the elevator would not have a proper set text outside of a placeholder "''leave elevator lol''". *Since [[V1.8.0]] and prior to [[V1.37.0]], all elevators in the lobby would teleport players to the [[Survival Intermission Lobby]] if in a private server. {{BrowseNavBox}} [[Category:Features]]
